top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months (26 TAC §747.1309(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver was missing training for the previous training year in the following topics:  Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome,  Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS),  Understanding early childhood brain development.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases (26 TAC §747.501(14))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operational policies did not provide information on how home is free of vaccine preventable diseases.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors (26 TAC §747.501(15))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the inspection, the operational policy did not include information related to maintaining and administering unassigned epinephrine auto-injectors.

top_violation_types.title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time a non-client resident 14 or older moves into your home or operation (26 TAC §745.621(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined that the primary caregiver did not submit a background check for a household member.

top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two of the four children records reviewed were missing health statements.
